content: Task: failure prediction on multivariate time series - estimate from a system's recorded signals whether it will fail within a horizon | requires: signals preceding known failures, recorded failure times, a chosen horizon | produces: a failure probability or remaining-useful-life estimate per system and time | families: ML, DL (survival and classification models on windowed features, sequence models) | metrics: precision and recall of warnings, and their lead time, against recorded failures
